# Totthobox (তথ্যবক্স)

> Totthobox is Bangladesh's premier comprehensive Bengali digital utility and knowledge platform. It provides accurate, free calculations, converters, national encyclopedic entries, and citizen services in Bengali.

## Core Online Tools
- Age Calculator: https://totthobox.com/tools/age-calculator
- Tax & VAT Calculator (NBR FY2024-25): https://totthobox.com/tools/tax-vat-calculator
- Image & Signature Resizer (300x300, 300x80): https://totthobox.com/tools/image-resizer
- Percentage Calculator: https://totthobox.com/tools/percentage-calculator
- QR Code Generator: https://totthobox.com/tools/qrcode-generator
- Password Generator: https://totthobox.com/tools/password-generator
- Word and Character Counter: https://totthobox.com/tools/word-and-character-counter
- Internet Speed Test: https://totthobox.com/tools/internet-speed-test

## Smart Measurement Converters
- Land Measurement (Katha, Shotok, Bigha, Acre): https://totthobox.com/converter/land
- Number to Bengali Words (Cheque & Receipt): https://totthobox.com/converter/number-to-word
- Currency & Forex Rates: https://totthobox.com/converter/currency
- Length Converter: https://totthobox.com/converter/length
- Weight & Mass Converter: https://totthobox.com/converter/weight
- Area Converter: https://totthobox.com/converter/area
- Time Converter: https://totthobox.com/converter/time
- Temperature Converter: https://totthobox.com/converter/temperature
